instruction: Candid medium shot of a sunny outdoor park. On the left, the woman in the black beanie and red t-shirt (R5) swings a giant white inflatable bowling pin high. In the center, the man in the red polo shirt (R3) swings his inflatable pin downward. On the right, the woman with the large afro in a red t-shirt (R6) stands smiling and watching. Bright daylight illuminates the green grass and trees.
elements: R5 swings a giant white inflatable bowling pin high
R3 swings his inflatable pin downward
R6 smiles and watches instead of swinging a pin
R3 and R5 are active inflatable-pin swingers while R6 is an observer
giant white inflatable bowling pins are used as props
sunny outdoor park with green grass and trees
